I'll start:

When I was 13, I was walking to my friend's house after school when I realized that if I took the alley way I'd reach his house faster. I cut through the alley and before I reached my friend's street I saw an orange cat with a litter of kittens laying by an old dumpster. They looked asleep but as I came closer I realized that the cat and all of her kittens were dead. Lines of pitch black ants were crawling all across their motionless faces, going in and out of every orifice, but most were coming out of her exposed, gaping ribcage. The smell of decay suddenly hit my nose and I started crying for her and her kittens. It was the first time in my life that I had ever witnessed death, in its truest, ugliest form, and this vivid memory will always be with me.
Anyone have any macabre memories they would like to share?

Almonds....

I was 16, skipping school with my best friend. We were cutting through a forest preserve in the South Burbs of Chicago.

On a bench, there was a man in a suit. He appeared to be crying. My friend and I stopped talking about Magic the Gathering and asked the man if he was okay. He didn't say anything to us, so we just kept walking

He had a revolver in a briefcase next to him, we were about 20 feet away when he put it under his chin and pulled the trigger.

My buddy and I never talked to each other about it really. It was at his bachelor party, once everyone else had left or passed out, we were sitting there getting philosophical, like only young drunk men can pretend to do, when he brought it up.

We talked about it for a while, little things we could have said or done differently to maybe stop the guy. I admitted to him that the whole thing smelled like Almonds to me. The smell of meat, bone, gunpowder, and shit all combined to smell like almonds to me. I haven't willingly eaten one since that day.

Thank you for your time
I'm sorry you and your friend had to witness that, especially at a young age. Nonetheless, that was a beautifully macabre memory. Thanks for sharing.

Thoughts on Touhou 15: Legacy of Lunatic Kingdom

It's by far the hardest Touhou game yet. While I love all the characters I also hate the bosses for being so darn hard. I've yet to actually beat Doremy, so I've been watching other people square off against Clownpiece+.

So far I haven't understood a bit of the story other than Hectica, Junko, and Clownpiece all wanting to take down Chang'e for messing with the sun.

(Yay, first post!)

Definitely the most difficult Touhou game so far. One of my friends went for Lunatic pointdevice and took more than 2600 retries to complete it. I've seen Jaimers91's replay on Youtube and he complained that while it is very difficult, the bullet patterns are unimaginative. I tend to agree.

I suppose the bullet patters are unimaginative, but they are very effective at what they are designed to do: kill the player. The game also gives off a very different feel than the other games. It feels a lot like other bullet-hell shumps to me than previous games because of the faster bullets and patterns that require a lot more memorization, especially stage 5. You just kind of have to know where the bullets will come from since you don't have time to move into a good position if you do not.
